verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents a synchronous webhook that lets developer code approve or decline authorization requests in real time, which is the core of this story. The pack does not show the network time budget or any documented timeout fallback the developer controls. missing for 10: documented response-time budget, documented timeout fallback behavior the developer can configure, independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time decisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can approve or decline each authorization in real time — a webhook or auth-stream endpoint my code answers inside the network's time budget, with a documented timeout fallback I control

citations.quote: Using the synchronous webhook, you can approve or decline authorization requests in real time.
